title: Calculator
aboutText: Whether you need to perform quick daily calculations, manage budgets, or solve arithmetic equations, this browser-based calculator provides a clean, responsive layout for fast mathematical evaluations.
addDesc: Sum up numbers and values quickly.
divDesc: Divide numbers instantly with precise results.
clearDesc: Reset the calculation screen to start fresh.
faq1Q: Does this calculator support decimal calculations?
faq1A: Yes, you can input floating-point decimal numbers using the period (.) key for high-precision math.
faq2Q: Is my calculation history saved online?
faq2A: No, calculations run locally in your web browser, ensuring complete privacy and speed.
